title: lichen-oscore ownership.rs:56 doc link to private item breaks strict rustdoc (human-routed)
description: Child of kpv0.7, filed per the oscore skip rule (human-only, not agent-workable). Fix is a doc-comment wording change (e.g. plain backticks) with zero semantics, but lichen-oscore is outside agent scope by policy. Blocks the kpv0.7 rustdoc gate from going fully green; everything else is fixed by kpv0.7(a).
